recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The fix is limited to the active Resource Type Index source page and makes existing links such as source/security.html's Security Category link behave as the Published Jira requested without changing resource content or unrelated tab templates.
issue_request: FHIR-34485 was Published/Persuasive for R5 as a non-substantive correction asking that direct links such as resourcelist.html#tab-7 open the Resource Type Index and activate the target sub-tab, especially Security Category.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged August 2022 commits d78907197b3fbbbafead95cc5d551aded6e3435c and 33f2b54394c0ef1ebe1260789bd3fc1567275624 implemented hash-addressable #tt-* tabs for generated resource pages. They did not change source/resourcelist.html, whose current script still selected the active tab from sessionStorage or tab 0.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini include resourcelist.html in the current build, and source/security.html links to resourcelist.html#tabs-7 for the Security Category tab. jQuery UI only auto-selects a location hash when the active option remains null; the resource list script supplied an active option before the hash could be considered. Zulip evidence confirms the original FHIR-34485 announcement covered resource-page #tt-* behavior, and no Confluence reference was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated source/resourcelist.html so its tab initialization first maps window.location.hash to a matching Resource Type Index tab. The mapping also accepts the issue's #tab-* form by normalizing it to the current #tabs-* ids, and falls back to stored tab state only when the URL does not name a resource-list tab.
source_changes: source/resourcelist.html: changed Resource Type Index tab setup to prefer window.location.hash, normalize #tab-* fragments to #tabs-*, and fall back to fhir-resourcelist-tab-index only when no hash tab matches.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue asking that Resource List sub-tab fragment links activate the target tab.
evidence_items.learned: This is final work-group intent and defines the expected behavior for resourcelist.html hash links.

evidence_items.summary: The Resource Type Index declares #tabs-* tab links and now maps window.location.hash to the active tab before falling back to session storage.
evidence_items.learned: The edited source directly implements the requested tab-fragment behavior on the active resource list page.

evidence_items.summary: Security narrative links to resourcelist.html#tabs-7, and the resource list page is present in the current navigation/publish configuration.
evidence_items.learned: The target page and fragment are in current build scope and have an existing source link that benefits from the fix.

evidence_items.summary: The Jira-tagged commits changed generated resource-page templates and #tt-* anchors but did not update source/resourcelist.html.
evidence_items.learned: Prior application addressed a related tab-navigation mechanism while leaving the named Resource List page incomplete.

evidence_items.learned: The announcement corroborates that the original applied work was resource-page #tt-* behavior, not resource-list #tabs-* activation.
